name: OAG-Bench
description: OAG-Bench is a comprehensive, multi-aspect, and fine-grained human-curated benchmark based on the Open Academic Graph for academic graph mining. It covers 10 tasks, 20 datasets, and includes over 70 baselines and 120 experimental results, providing standardized evaluation protocols to facilitate research in academic graph mining.
typical_sota_score: varies by task (e.g., often ~75–95% for node classification; lower and task-dependent for link prediction and tracing tasks)
reputation: A well-regarded academic graph mining benchmark that has become a common reference point for evaluating node, link, and graph-level methods on Open Academic Graph data.
notes: Includes new data annotation strategies and a suite of data pre-processing codes, algorithm implementations, and standardized evaluation protocols.
